fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the effect is triggered by casting a Basic Ability.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.description: After 1 second, deal 345 damage in an area. Verdant Spheres increases the radius by 50%.

fields.notes: Delay starts after the cast goes through, making the total time after initiating cast to damage being dealt 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Living Bomb
abilities.description: Deal 126 damage over 3 seconds to an enemy, then they explode dealing 215 damage to all nearby enemies. Other Heroes damaged by this explosion are also affected by Living Bomb, though the secondary explosions cannot spread. Verdant Spheres makes this Ability cost no Mana and have no cooldown.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Damage over Time
fields.notes: Casting Living Bomb will prevent Basic Attacks for 0.25 seconds Living Bomb cannot spread to targets already affected by another Living Bomb. Main target takes damage from both periodic and explosion damage. Explosion damage is displayed in the target unit's Health bar as if it were a DoT, but does not count as one, allowing it to interrupt Weak Channels (e.g. Mounting & Hearthing). If the target dies while affected by Living Bomb, it explodes immediately. Effects that remove DoTs prevent Living Bomb from exploding.

abilities.name: Gravity Lapse
abilities.description: Stun the first enemy hit for 1 seconds. Verdant Spheres causes Gravity Lapse to stun the first 3 enemies hit and increases the stun duration by 50%.

abilities.name: Phoenix
abilities.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 damage and splashing for 42 damage.; 60; 80; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Summon figment, Splash
fields.notes: Phoenix will prioritize attacking the last enemy Hero hit during its launch. If no Hero is hit, or the target leaves its Attack Range, Phoenix will attack the nearest enemy to the center, prioritizing Heroes.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 damage to an enemy Hero and 405 damage to enemies nearby.; 100; 80; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Revealed
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. The cast is interrupted, if the target moves 5 units past its range during windup, or if Kael'thas issues a "move" or "stop" command. Pyroblast missile can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 30 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the missile expires upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the missile will keep redirecting to the target unit. Pyroblast always explodes, applying its area effects upon reaching the end location, regardless of being able to hit its original target. Main target does not take area damage.
